item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 16/Jun/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The trough of low pressure now bringing heavy showers and squally thunderstorms to the coast of southern China will move inland in the next couple of days. Under the influence of a southwesterly airstream, the weather will be hot apart from a few showers over the coast of southern China early next week. Another trough of low pressure is expected to affect Guangdong midweek next week and bring unsettled weather to the region.

Date/Month: 17/06 (Saturday)
Wind: South to southwest force 4, occasionally force 5 offshore.
Weather: Mainly cloudy with showers. Showers will be heavy at times with a few squally thunderstorms at first. Showers will gradually ease off later.
Temp range: 26 - 31 C
R.H. range: 75 - 95 per Cent
PSR: High
